description:
Supply and demand for one district or authority by month: new listings,
    reductions, reduction share, asking-to-sold, days on market, plus the daily
    live stock. Use it for "is this market heating up or cooling". area_type is postcode_district (lowercase, e.g. 'w14'), local_authority (GSS code,
    e.g. 'E09000012'), county or country; area_code is that code. Free text is refused: call
    resolve_place first.

    At most 36 months. Days on market is observed only from Sep 2026 (the
    reply states the start date) and, with asking-to-sold, is HIDDEN where fewer
    than 10 sales matched: never quote it then. Withdrawals and months of supply
    are not published (`not_published`); do not derive them.

    Do NOT use it to value a property. Free; covered=false or an upstream
    failure is not charged. Free.
name: market_flow
title: Supply and demand by month
